title: LingSante-Pulse: Unified Physiological Pretraining through Random-Feature Prediction and Cross-Modal Alignment
abstract: arXiv:2611.27206v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Clinical monitoring and wearable devices capture complementary physiological signals, but their partially overlapping modality coverage makes within-signal information and cross-modal relationships difficult to exploit jointly. We introduce LingSante-Pulse, a unified, general-purpose and flexible physiological representation framework that learns from these heterogeneous recordings. A shared, signal-conditioned encoder processes each physical channel independently and supports different numbers and combinations of signals for multimodal assessment and single-sensor inference. Pairwise cross-modal alignment, structured random-feature prediction (RFP) and masked waveform reconstruction jointly learn physiological relationships and preserve informative within-signal structure. Across 38 general physiological task configurations spanning PPG, ECG, EEG and EMG, the frozen encoder achieves the best dataset-balanced mean rank in each domain.

translated_title: LingSante-Pulse：通过随机特征预测与跨模态对齐实现的统一生理信号预训练
translated_abstract: 临床监护与可穿戴设备采集互补的生理信号，但其模态覆盖部分重叠，导致信号内信息与跨模态关系难以被联合利用。我们提出了LingSante-Pulse，一个统一、通用且灵活的生理信号表示框架，可从这些异构记录中学习。该框架采用一个共享的、以信号为条件的编码器，独立处理每个物理通道，并支持不同数量和组合的信号，从而兼顾多模态评估与单传感器推理。成对跨模态对齐、结构化随机特征预测（RFP）与掩码波形重建三者协同工作，共同学习生理关系并保留具有信息量的信号内结构。在涵盖PPG、ECG、EEG和EMG的38个通用生理任务配置中，冻结编码器在每个领域均取得了按数据集平衡的最佳平均排名。
tldr: 该论文提出统一生理预训练框架LingSante-Pulse，通过随机特征预测、跨模态对齐与掩码波形重建学习通用生理信号表示，在涵盖PPG、ECG、EEG和EMG的38个任务配置的每个领域均取得最佳排名。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces LingSante-Pulse, a unified physiological pretraining framework that learns universal representations via random-feature prediction, cross-modal alignment, and masked waveform reconstruction, achieving the best dataset-balanced rank in every domain across 38 task configurations spanning PPG, ECG, EEG, and EMG.
